title: Citric acid-modulated carbon dots derived from black tea waste for multifunctional food packaging: anti-counterfeiting and UV-protective preservation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,27707-27717
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA03143A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yulu Liu, Jiamin Li, Yizhou Xiao, Yuchi Chen, Yunkai Zhou, Fangmei Zhou, Bingqi Zhu, Wenxiao Jiang, Xing Chen, Guangming Li
Bright fluorescent carbon dots derived from black tea waste and citric acid showed a 25.5-fold increase in quantum yield, enabling use as anti-counterfeiting ink for food packaging and for strawberry preservation.
